result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback T4C position by giving Licensee a convenience right on 90 days’ written notice, imposing no express early-termination fee, and giving Licensor no convenience right during the term. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks 30-day notice and an express pro-rata refund. The redline is not minimal and changes unrelated rights by replacing Licensor’s immediate breach remedy with mutual material-breach termination and a cure period, while also adding an SLA-failure right. Drafting is poor because the phrase linking Licensee’s termination right to prohibiting its own use is incoherent, and the subsequent reference to “such immediate termination” no longer aligns with the revised language.
